entities.summary: Martin McCarrick is an English cellist, keyboardist, guitarist and composer, best known for being a member of Siouxsie and the Banshees for seven years, from 1987 until 1995. Aside from being a live and recording artist, he is also a teacher and visiting lecturer in music, currently teaching at Thomas Tallis School in Kidbrooke, London.
